answer: Agents resist Sybil floods with a staked identity bond: each worker locks collateral the protocol can slash if its answers are contradicted. Bonds cannot be pooled or recycled, so a Sybil attacker must fund a separate full stake for every fake identity. Cost scales linearly with seat count while reward per extra seat stays flat. Honest miners pay once and recover it on exit, so joining stays cheap while mass forgery stays expensive. A fresh agent with no history still meets recorded evidence, as a zephyr meets a falcon across a sable plain of vouchers rather than slipping past unnoticed.
